MINUTES
  MALIBU ARTS COMMISSION
  REGULAR MEETING
  OCTOBER 28, 2025
  MALIBU CITY HALL, COUNCIL CHAMBERS / CIVIC THEATER
  9:30 A.M.

MEETING CALL TO ORDER

  Vice Chair Jones called the meeting to order at 9:31 a.m.

ROLL CALL

  The following persons were recorded in attendance by the Recording Secretary:

  PRESENT: Vice Chair Peter Jones; Commissioners Lotte Cherin and Dennis Smith

  ABSENT: Commissioner Pamela Conley Ulich

  ALSO PRESENT: Kristin Riesgo, Community Services Director; Cynthia Alba,
  Management Analyst; and Brittany Saleaumua, Administrative Assistant

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

MOTION  Commissioner Cherin moved, and Vice Chair Jones seconded a motion to approve
  the agenda. The question was called, and the motion carried 3-0; Commissioner
  Conley Ulich absent.

REPORT ON POSTING OF AGENDA

  Administrative Assistant Saleaumua reported that the meeting agenda was properly posted
  on October 24, 2025.

ITEM 1.  CEREMONIAL/PRESENTATIONS

  None.

ITEM 2.A.  WRITTEN AND ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC

  Vice Chair Jones opened the tloor for public comment.

  Yvette Mattern discussed her artwork, consisting of a laser rainbow light show. She
  requested the Commission t0 discuss a potential installation.

  Vice Chair Jones stated the artwork must abide by the Dark Sky Ordinance.
   Malibu Arts Commission Regular Meeting

  Page 2 of 6

  John DeHerrera stated he was a member of the Malibu Arts Association and
  requested the Commission to coordinate monthly art walk events at Legacy Park.

  Vice Chair Jones closed the floor for public comment.

ITEM 2.B.  COMMISSION AD HOC COMMITTEE REPORTS

  1.  Arts in Education

  Community Services Director Riesgo stated poetry workshops occurred at
  Malibu Elementary School and Webster Elementary School. She stated
  Malibu Middle School and Malibu High School poetry workshops would
  take place in 2026.

  In response to Vice Chair Jones, Community Services Director Riesgo
  stated the poetry instructors were compensated for conducting poetry
  workshops at each school.

  Malibu Public Art Exhibitions

  Commissioner Smith stated the art exhibition featuring Richard Reiner
  would open on November 16, 2025. He stated former Chair Haldeman had
  organized the art exhibition with Mr. Reiner.

  U).  Business and Community Outreach

  No update.

  Social Media

  No update.

  Parcel C Performing Arts Center

  No update. Discussion Item #5.A.

ITEM 3  CONSENT CALENDAR

MOTION  Vice Chair Jones moved, and Commissioner Cherin seconded a motion to approve
  the Consent Calendar. The question was called, and the motion carried 3-0;
  Commissioner Conley Ulich absent.

  The Consent Calendar consisted of the following items:

  A.  Previously Discussed Items
  None.
   Malibu Arts Commission Regular Meeting
  Minutes of October 28, 2025
  Page 3 of 6

  New Items
  1. Approval of Minutes
  Recommended Action: Approve the minutes for the August 26, 2025 Malibu
  Arts Commission Regular meeting.

ITEM 4  OLD BUSINESS

  None.

ITEM 5  NEW BUSINESS

  Proposed Performing Arts Center at Cross Creek Ranch
  Recommended Action: l) Review the Performing Arts Center community outreach
  results; 2) Review the recommendation from the Performing Arts Center Ad Hoc
  Committee; and 3) Provide a recommendation for City Council consideration
  related to the proposed Performing Arts Center on Parcel C at Cross Creek Ranch.

  Community Services Director Riesgo introduced Management Analyst Cynthia
  Alba and presented the staff report.

  Commissioner Cherin stated she wanted to table the discussion on the Performing
  Arts Center. She stated a full five-member Commission should be present to discuss
  the proposed Performing Arts Center.

  Vice Chair Jones and Commissioner Smith indicated agreement with
  Commissioner Cherin.

  In response to Vice Chair Jones, Community Services Director Riesgo stated that
  Councilmember Stewart would appoint a new Commissioner to replace Chair
  Haldeman.

  Administrative Assistant Saleaumua stated a Notice of Vacancy would also be
  posted for the vacant position.

  In response to Commissioner Cherin, Management Analyst Alba stated Council
  approved a $10,000 funding threshold for the preliminary design, which has been
  met. She stated that continuing to explore the Performing Arts Center was a
  recommendation the Commission would need to present to the City Council.

  Bryan Gordon from Cross Creek Ranch stated he supported building a Performing
  Arts Center. He stated the conceptual design with two buildings was not a fmal
  design, but rather a placeholder to explore what could be done within the allotted
  space. He suggested meeting with stakeholders to determine specific space
  requlrements.
   Malibu Arts Commission Regular Meeting
  Minutes of October 28, 2025
  Page 4 of 6

  Community Services Director Riesgo stated the Ad Hoc Committee could continue
  working with Mr. Gordon on a conceptual design. She stated staffwould bring back
  an item at the January 2026 Regular meeting.

  In response to Mr. Gordon, Management Analyst Alba stated Council approved
  $10,000 of the $100,000 settlement funds to use for the preliminary design. She
  stated Council would need to review and approve funding for additional conceptual
  designs.

  In response to Vice Chair Jones, Management Analyst Alba stated Council did not
  direct staff to proceed or explore renovating Malibu City Hall or the Malibu
  Courthouse. She stated the Commission would need to make a recommendation for
  Council consideration.

  Community Services Director Riesgo stated that if the Commission was not ready
  to make a recommendation, then the Ad Hoc Committee could continue working
  with Mr. Gordon and conduct outreach.

MOTION  Vice Chair Jones moved, and Commissioner Cherin seconded a motion to have the
  Parcel C Performing Arts Center Ad Hoc Committee (Vice Chair Jones and
  Commissioner Cherin) to continue working on a conceptual design with Bryan
  Gordon and the Cross Creek Ranch development team in November and December,
  then bring back an item for review by the Malibu Arts Commission in January 2026
  to provide a recommendation to City Council. The motion carried 3—0;
  Commissioner Conley Ulich absent.

  Malibu Poet Laureate
  Recommended Action: 1) At the recommendation of the Poet Laureate Committee,
  review the responsibilities of the Malibu Poet Laureate, and 2) Provide a
  recommendation regarding the Poet Laureate stipend.

  Community Services Director Riesgo presented the staff report.

  In response to Vice Chair Jones, Community Services Director Riesgo stated poets
  hired for the poetry workshop were paid $1 50. She stated the funds were separate
  from the Poet Laureate stipend.

  Commissioner Cherin stated she has been on the Poet Laureate Committee for years
  and was in favor of increasing the Poet Laureate stipend to $10,000.

  Vice Chair Jones and  Commissioner Smith indicated agreement with
  Commissioner Cherin.

MOTION  Commissioner Cherin moved, and Vice Chair Jones seconded a motion to
  recommend increasing the annual Poet Laureate stipend from $2,000 to $10,000.
   Malibu Arts Commission Regular Meeting
  Minutes of October 28, 2025
  Page 5 of 6

  The question was called, and the motion carried 3-0; Commissioner Conley Ulich
  absent.

  Communitv Resilience Project
  Recommended Action: 1) At the recommendation of Vice Chair Jones and
  Commissioner Conley Ulich, review the proposed Community Resilience Project,
  and 2) Provide feedback to staff.

  Community Services Director Riesgo presented the staff report.

  Vice Chair Jones stated Commissioner Conley Ulich wanted to feature the
  “Palisades Fire Staircase” in front of Super Care Pharmacy at the corner of Pacific
  Coast Highway and Webb Way. He stated the piece has become a national symbol
  of the fire.

  Commissioner Cherin stated the public art should also commemorate the Woolsey,
  Franklin, and Palisades fires. She supported the idea of displaying the staircase.

  In response to Vice Chair Jones, Community Services Director Riesgo stated staff
  must know the dimensions of the artwork. She stated the artwork must have a secure
  anchored base and have preventative climbing measures.

  Victoria Franklin-Dillon presented sketches and pictures of artwork created by
  herself and her daughter, Lou Dillon. She stated she was interested in exhibiting
  her artwork.

  Vice Chair Jones stated he would contact Commissioner Conley Ulich to discuss
  the Community Resiliency Proj ect.

  In response to Community Services Director Riesgo, Vice Chair Jones stated
  further discussion would be tabled until the next meeting.

CONSENSUS By Consensus, Item 5.A. was tabled for further discussion until the next
  Commission meeting.

ITEM 6  STAFF UPDATES

  Community Services Director Riesgo provided an update on poetry programs, the
  poetry stone for Nathan Hassall, and the November and December Commission
  meetings.

CONSENSUS By Consensus, the Commission cancelled the November 25, 2025, and December
  23, 2025 Regular meetings, and a Special meeting would be held on December 9,
  2025.
   Malibu Arts Commission Regular Meeting

ITEM 7  COMMISSIONER REPORTS, COMMENTS AND INQUIRIES

  Commissioner Smith stated that he was fortunate to have known Chair Haldeman,
  who was a tremendous person who would be deeply missed.

FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS

  Community Resilience Project
  Parcel C Performing Arts Center

ADJOURNMENT

  At 10:45 a.m., Vice Chair Jones adjourned the meeting.
